type ByNumber<T extends { [n: number]: string }> = T[0];
type ByNumericString<T extends { [n: number]: string }> = T["0"];
type ByFraction<T extends { [n: number]: string }> = T["1.5"];
type ByNegative<T extends { [n: number]: string }> = T[-1];
type ByString<T extends { [n: string]: string }> = T[0];
type First<T extends Array<number>> = T[0];
type Second<T extends [number, string]> = T[1];
type TupleName<T extends [string]> = T["0"];
type Length<T extends string> = T["length"];
type Shared<T extends { a: 1 } | { a: 2; b: 3 }> = T["a"];
type Both<T extends { a: 1 } & { b: 2 }> = T["b"];
type Inherited<T extends { a: string }, U extends T> = U["a"];
type Never<T extends never> = T["x"];
const byNumber: ByNumber<{ [n: number]: string }> = "zero";
const byNumericString: ByNumericString<string[]> = "one";
const first: First<number[]> = 1;
const second: Second<[number, string]> = "two";
const textLength: Length<"abc"> = 3;
const shared: Shared<{ a: 2; b: 3 }> = 2;
console.log(byNumber, byNumericString, first, second, textLength, shared);
